title: Town hall: Private deployment roadmap — quick framing + Q&A (scratch)
body:
Purpose: quick internal scratch to land a 3–5 minute framing at the next town hall + a compact Q&A crib. NOT final. Use this to align exec lines and flag escalation questions for SRE/infra/product.

Audience/context:
- company all-hands (~30m). We get ~500 live + recording. Keep it simple and forward-looking.
- primary objective: explain why we are prioritizing Private (VPC/on-prem) investments this quarter, what customers should expect, and what it means for hosted/dedicated.
- secondary: surface support/ops changes and announce pilot timelines.

Top-level framing (3 slides / 3 min):
1) Why now (30–45s): demand signals -> regulated customers and larger enterprise security/compliance asks; performance/cost controls customers want in-region + private networking; strategic: differentiate from commodity hosted-only offerings.
2) What we are shipping (60–90s): Private control plane (beta), on-prem runtime installer (alpha), dedicated VPC integrations + KMS/HSM options, hardened audit logging & SIEM hooks.
3) Customer impact & timeline (45–60s): beta invites in Q2; GA targets Q3 with tiered SLAs for enterprise; expected early adopter feedback loop to inform Dedicated autoscale policies.

Script (concise) — CEO (30–45s)
- One-liner: "We built Redwood to let engineers ship LLM experiences reliably — today we're making that possible for the most security-conscious customers."
- Why it matters: trust & control = new revenue motion; it unlocks higher ARR ACV.
- High-level ask: "We need discipline on SLOs, docs, and onboarding. If you see a gap, flag it to the exec comm thread."

Script — Head of Product (30–45s)
- Quick bullets: what beta includes, enrollment criteria, expected GA tradeoffs.
- Call to action for docs / SDK teams to prioritize private deployment quickstarts.

Anticipated questions + short answers (rapid Q&A crib):
Q: Does Private mean we deprioritize hosted API?
A: No. Hosted remains our primary PLG funnel and core offering. Private is additive — targets bigger deals where customers need isolation/SLA.

Q: Will pricing change?
A: Yes, pricing for Private is contract-based (reserved capacity + platform fee). We will publish a beta pricing guideline for sales next week (DOCS-88).

Q: How different is this from Dedicated?
A: Dedicated = Redwood-managed reserved GPU pools in our infra; Private = customer-managed control plane or on-prem runtime with stronger network isolation. There will be overlap but different operational models.

Q: What about data residency and compliance?
A: Private ships with KMS integrations, audit logs, and optional air-gapped installer. We are also tracking SOC2/ISO requirements; compliance package roadmap in Confluence link above.

Harder / escalation questions to prep responses for:
- "What SLA/penalties do we commit to for Private?" -> need legal + sales on draft SLOs (work with Legal, list of baseline SLAs).
- "How will upgrades / security patches be handled for on-prem?" -> ops playbook required; define support tiers.
- "Are we open-sourcing any part of the installer?" -> TBD; coordinate with OSS policy.

Open items (TODOs) — action owners & deadlines:
- Finalize beta enrollment criteria (product) — owner: Elena — due 2026-03-17.
- Publish beta pricing guideline for Sales (finance + revops) — owner: Jonas — due 2026-03-12 (urgent).
- Confirm on-prem install E2E test plan and rollback story (SRE) — owner: Maya — due 2026-03-19.
- Short quickstart doc + SDK snippets (DX) — owner: docs team — due 2026-03-24.

Comms checklist (internal before town hall):
- [ ] Exec dry run (this will be scheduled + recording) — owners: Izaac & Maya.
- [ ] Post-town-hall FAQ + Confluence update — owner: Elena.
- [ ] Sales enablement 1-pager + battlecards — owner: Jonas.

Notes to self / drafting fragments:
- Consider 1 customer quote (anonymized) about security requirements (good signal).
- Keep metrics lightweight: pipeline with private interest (e.g., "~15 opportunities >$200k ACV in late-stage pipeline") — confirm with RevOps.
- Avoid technical deep-dive during town hall; route those to product office hours.

Slack / follow-ups:
- Post summary in #all-hands after talk with links to: Confluence PD-ROADMAP-2026, sales one-pager, beta sign-up form.
- Thread in #eng-infra for upgrade/rollback discussion; tag SRE on the hard escalation Qs.

Feedback request:
- Please add quick edits to this doc or drop suggestions in the exec-comm thread by EOD 2026-03-11. I will iterate slides and send final script by 2026-03-12.

Rough slide titles (for slide builder)
- Slide 1: "Why Private matters now" (1 stat + 1 quote)
- Slide 2: "What we're shipping" (bullets + timeline)
- Slide 3: "Customer impact & how to help" (call to action)
- Backup slide: "Anticipated Qs" (bullet answers)

Versioning: this is a living scratchpad. Move to shared_drives/company/messaging when finalized.

-- Izaac
